# Vanderbilt University School of Medicine

> Vanderbilt School of Medicine's official hub featuring news, student stories, research highlights, and information about its distinctive MD and MSTP programs.

The site showcases Vanderbilt University School of Medicine's commitment to medical education, student development, and research excellence. It highlights student achievements, program information, and the vibrant community within the institution.

## Key Topics

- Vanderbilt University School of Medicine
- MSTP (Medical Scientist Training Program)
- Student achievements
- Professional development
- Student life and community
- Medical education
- Research highlights
- Faculty recognition
- Wellness and community events
- Diversity and heritage months
- Vanderbilt University Medical Center
- Master of Genetic Counseling
- Commencement and awards

## Core Information

- [Why VUSM](https://medschool.vanderbilt.edu/about/why-vusm): Overview of Vanderbilt School of Medicine's mission and distinctive features
- [News Hub](https://medschool.vanderbilt.edu/news): News hub featuring student stories, research highlights, and alumni updates

- [Rachael Jameson MPH Discusses Child Policy Research](https://medschool.vanderbilt.edu/2021/09/13/jameson-discusses-child-policy-research): MPH student profile on adverse childhood experiences policy research
- [M4s Brian Song and Kyoko Kohno Find Their Perfect Match](https://medschool.vanderbilt.edu/2026/02/14/m4s-brian-song-and-kyoko-kohno-find-their-perfect-match): Student spotlight on M4 students and Vanderbilt medical school community
